inputs.text: 16-bit pixel art game sprite of a tiny cute chibi robot mascot, front view, upper body only, cut off at the waist. Oversized round glossy helmet head in soft lavender white, a large rounded dark navy visor screen covering the face, two glowing amber orange rounded-rectangle pixel eyes on the visor, a short antenna with a glowing amber ball on top. Small rounded body with thin indigo panel lines and a little amber chest light. Its right arm is raised high, waving hello with a round mitten hand, the other hand resting at the bottom edge. Friendly, joyful, toy-like, clean crisp pixels, limited palette of lavender white, pale violet, indigo, dark navy and amber, hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, flat solid pure green background, centered, no text
